seconds_cover: the whole deep check, the file checks included; their weights were loaded before timing, as the page loads them before it says Ready

note.summary: A valid Content Credentials manifest says AI was used to make or edit this image. That tells you how it was made, not whether any claim about it is true.

evidence.finding: C2PA manifest signed by Adobe Inc. on 2024-06-14 via Adobe_Firefly adobe_c2pa/0.10.1 c2pa-rs/0.31.1; it declares it was made with generative AI (trainedAlgorithmicMedia). The signer is on the C2PA interim trust list, which C2PA describes as temporary.
evidence.proves: The signer recorded that this content came from an AI generator. The signer chains to that list and the file has not changed since it was signed.
evidence.does_not_prove: Who made it or why; only that the signing tool labelled it AI-made.

evidence.finding: Community Forensics detector score 0.159 out of 1. This score raises no concern on its own.
evidence.proves: Nothing on its own. A threshold of 0.432 was frozen in advance, and our test of it failed. In that test, the upper bound on false flags for photos in their original format was 9.7%, above the 2% limit. See docs/RESULTS-v2.md.
evidence.does_not_prove: A low score is not proof that a camera took it. Many AI images score low, especially after compression or from generators the model never saw.

gate.reason: original: false-positive upper bound 9.718% is above 2%

evidence.finding: Second Look's own watermark was not found: 104 of 256 bits match our message, near the 128 expected by chance.
evidence.proves: Only that our own mark is not readable in this copy.
evidence.does_not_prove: The absence of a mark says nothing about how the image was made. This looks only for Second Look's own mark. It does not detect Meta AI images or any other company's watermark.

raw.model: Meta Video Seal 1.0 (image model y_256b_img, TorchScript)
